text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first of the Classic Triple Crown battles, the Satsuki Sho, is upon us. The hype for this race is on a different level from any other so far.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some fans consider Eishin Flash a cut below her competitors… but her approach remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's business as usual for her as she makes for the track with her gaze fixed straight ahead.
